workingDatumBasis: Inspected a contractor clock-construction photograph and a completed lower-tower/tent photograph. They establish the large gold-edged dial, warm ribbed hotel facades and pale tensioned roof tents; they do not certify the completed crescent or exact whole-complex crown. Preserve original601m source height,23m crescent and existing mapped seven-tower/podium layout. Main clock shaft remains separately offset at[39.82553895,21.41812445] and internally aligned cardinally; six named lower parts retain their plans and authored heights. Standard viewer PMTiles confirms the Great Mosque/complex context. Off-podium PMTiles point[0,140]328.125m sets approximate ground contact; center333.3364m and nearby hills are coarse. Rectangular preview contact correction covers the complex, with raw terrain kept separately. Exact tent sag, clock typography, calligraphy, mosaic ornament, entrances and thresholds remain approximate or omitted. Existing601/607m datum disagreement remains documented; no new survey is claimed.

previewContactCorrection.basis: Bounded local preview correction removes coarse roof imprint; raw PMTiles samples retained separately. Ground contact is approximate.
